description: Built a Python audit log analyser for cloud medical systems, an Angular/TypeScript timeline platform with custom playback and annotation for device/log analysis, and led R&D on 3D anatomical mesh comparison using Open3D and non-rigid ICP registration.

Built a real-time avionics viewport emulator in C/C++ and OpenGL with camera feedback and HUD overlays, integrating WGS84 coordinate transforms and geodesic calculations with hardware abstraction for testing without physical equipment.

Managed setup, configuration, and testing of IoT devices (Airconsole, Smartalock, Floorsense) while streamlining inventory tracking through software tools, audits, and process documentation to improve accuracy and reduce hardware loss.
